product.name: Velara DriveCam 4K
product.description: The Velara DriveCam 4K delivers crystal‑clear footage for everyday driving and safety monitoring. Its 4K sensor captures 60 frames per second, while a built‑in night‑vision mode ensures visibility in low light. The compact unit mounts directly to the windshield with a suction‑based bracket and connects to the vehicle’s 12‑V power supply. A micro‑SD slot supports up to 128GB of storage, and a dedicated app allows real‑time playback and cloud backup. Designed for durability, the camera’s polycarbonate housing resists impact and the matte black finish blends seamlessly with any interior.
